scope: Shopping Curator product search and current/list prices; API-only link creation remains gated until a live scoped member identity can be read and bound.

commission.qualification: Official guide labels these basic rates; promotional commission may change them. No rate is hard-coded into the product API client.

request.authentication: Curator Authorization/session required by the existing adapter; no public anonymous contract is established.

response.paginationSemantics: Unknown for product search; page request parameters are accepted by the bundle, but no next-page or total-count guarantee is included in the adapter.

priceNormalization.currentPriceMeaning: The official Curator result card maps priceToPay to its currentPrice display prop.
priceNormalization.listPriceMeaning: The same card maps originalPrice separately; it is not recomputed from discountRate.

catalogSearch.blocker: The current worker has no Olive Young Curator session. Anonymous direct search returned 403 text/html.

productDetail.blocker: No standalone product-detail XHR contract was observed or independently replayed. The web route is not represented as an API operation.

curatorLinkCreation.memberBinding: The observed status response has no member identifier. The new commerce surface refuses createLink until an authenticated member identity read and expected-member match are available.
curatorLinkCreation.writeOutcome: No link was created in this run.

officialGuideTerms.advertisingDisclosure: The official guide requires an economic-interest disclosure for externally shared product links.
officialGuideTerms.attribution: The official guide describes a 24-hour attribution window and last-click qualification.
